show.description: When 19-year-old Isha discovers she is mysteriously pregnant, her own family abandons her. A chance encounter with billionaire Shikhar Ahuja changes her fate, but living under his roof draws her into scandal, betrayal, and danger — until his son Dhruv becomes the unexpected protector of her unborn children… and her heart.
